frequency_question: How often does institutional inertia, bureaucratic friction, or inter-agency pushback successfully block an intended upward adjustment of a countercyclical capital buffer once initiated by the principal?
membership_rule: Includes any formal consideration or proposal to raise the CCyB by a major central bank board where the leadership signaled intent. Excludes routine microprudential capital requirements.

cases.name: Bank of England FPC CCyB implementation 2016
Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB hike 2018
Swiss National Bank countercyclical buffer activation 2022
Federal Reserve Board discussion and non-action periods 2016-2019

coverage_note: 5 named key jurisdictional cycles; believed representative of developed market central banking behavior.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market central banks where political economy differs significantly.
skeleton: Central bank regulatory tightening cycles with stated intent vs actual final implementation above baseline over a standard multi-year window.
validity_reason: Macroprudential governance frameworks and institutional friction structures evolve slowly over decades.
